table backends: CREATE TABLE "backends" ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, -- rowid alias; stable across renames name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, -- operator-facing label base_url TEXT NOT NULL, api_key_env TEXT, -- env-var NAME, never the key value api_key_ct BLOB, api_key_nonce BLOB, weight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, max_inflight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 16, health_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '/models', supports_edit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- 0/1 (image pools only) enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, -- 0 = drained for maintenance created_at TEXT NOT NULL, -- RFC3339 UTC updated_at TEXT NOT NULL , priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"mode":"auto"}' CHECK (json_valid(priority)), extra_headers TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}') STRICT
